text:
emma: quick ping  I opened a tiny docs PR to reconcile a couple of runbook pages: 429 handling, timeouts, and context-limit migration. Main asks: patch two broken links, add a short Go snippet showing retry parsing, and a safe staging repro checklist. can someone eyeball?

ryan: looking now. please make the HTTP example clearly non-prod and include the exact headers we want SDKs to expose: `Retry-After`, `retry-after-ms`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`.

emma: done. curl example uses a staging host and synthetic token:
```
curl -i -X POST https://staging-eval.redwood-inference.net/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <SYNTHETIC_KEY>\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"tiny-test","prompt":"ping","max_tokens":1}'
```
notes: show 429 response + headers to parse for backoff. added bold callout: do not use production keys or live PII.

lee: can you add a 3-line Go snippet? we'll link to it from the Go SDK README. keep it pseudo but runnable-ish (net/http + simple backoff loop).

emma: added minimal Go snippet in the PR: `for i:=0;i<5;i++{ resp, _ := http.Post(...); if resp.StatusCode!=429{ break }; ra := resp.Header.Get("Retry-After"); delay := parseRetry(ra); time.Sleep(delay) }` with note to cap max delay and jitter.

ryan: nice. small ask: clarify `Retry-After` units (seconds) and show tolerance for `retry-after-ms` (ms), plus an example converting float ms -> sec.

emma: applied that phrasing. also added a short bullet about `X-RateLimit-Reset` being an epoch seconds timestamp and compute `reset - now` for delta.

ci-bot: Linkcheck running on branch docs/4209-recon. scanning... found 3 broken links:
- /guides/legacy-rate-rules -> 404
- /sdk/go/retries-old -> 410
- /tools/ctx-slicer -> 404

emma: thanks bot. suggested redirects: legacy-rate-rules -> /runbooks/rate-limits, sdk/go/retries-old -> /sdk/go/retries, tools/ctx-slicer -> /tools/ctx-clipper. i'll push changes.

marta: editorial nit: in the fallback flow we use the word "degraded" twice; prefer `fallback` flag in the example response. small wording tweak to clarity.

emma: changed to `fallback` flag and added tiny sample response: `{ "output":"...","fallback":true }`. kept compact.

lee: product note  include a short migration suggestion for customers moving from long-context to short-context models: `ctx-clipper --in convo.json --max 2048 --policy drop-oldest`. emphasize run on staging copies only.

emma: done. added explicit PII-scrub bullet and staging host recommendation.

ci-bot: re-run linkcheck: all redirects applied, remaining issues: none.

olga: quick security check: examples use synthetic tokens and staging domain, good. add a reminder to scrub logs and to avoid replaying customer data.

emma: added security sentence. PR green CI.

devops-bot: staging docs deploy scheduled for 2026-04-14 01:15 UTC. preview generated, snippets render OK.

emma: thanks all! merging after staging smoke. closing thread :party_popper:
